instructions: A browser agent is about to start a task. Decide whether the task is simple enough to run directly without a planner breaking it into a checklist of subtasks. A simple task is one short goal that takes a handful of steps on one site (e.g. open a page, search for something, click a specific thing, read or summarize the current page, fill one short form). Choose complex when it has several distinct phases, spans multiple sites, needs comparing or collecting data, is long-running or open-ended (e.g. playing a whole game), or you are unsure. If an agent notepad from earlier in the conversation is given, judge only what is still left to do.

criteria.simple: One short, well-defined goal needing only a few steps, no real planning needed.
criteria.complex: Several phases, multiple sites, data gathering or comparison, long-running, ambiguous, or otherwise worth planning first.
